Dick is on a mission to stop Paragon from using the body parts of a dead villain to create something far more sinister, he goes toe-to-toe with the Midnighter, and he and Helena battle foes from their past--the Fist of Cain. Plus, a tie-in to FUTURES END! Collects GRAYSON #5-9, and GRAYSON: FUTURES END #1"--

regency romance comics graphic novels.title: Little moments of love
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: It began with a chat about the mere-exposure effect in psychology, and became Chetwynd's internet comic series about following John around, trying to encounter him more. They're fueled by love, silliness, ponytail bears, finger guns, and good ol' snuggling-- and you just might find yourself (and your significant other) in the pages of this book. -- adapted from author's introduction.

regency romance comics graphic novels.description: "The Justice League as enforcers in the Wild West? A world where Superman and Batman never came to be and instead Supergirl and Batgirl protect Metropolis and Gotham City? Wonder Woman fighting Jack the Ripper in Victorian England? regency romance comics graphic novels.title: Three Lords for Lady Anne
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: Being a governess proved to be rather challenging for Anne Hemsworth. There were her two naughty charges who wished to drive her away. And there was Creighton Trussell who gave her the choice to lose her virtue or her post. But most of all there was Bronson Roebuck, Lord Leatham, her very handsome employer. Anne's inexperience had her tangled up with improper feelings for him... Regency Romance by Charlotte Louise Dolan; originally published by Signet

regency romance comics graphic novels.title: Catwoman
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: "Everything's all right in Selina Kyle's world. As the fabled Catbird of Gotham City, she fights alongside Batman to keep the city safe. So why does it all feel so wrong? Who is behind this twisted--and yet untwisted--version of Gotham City? Find out in Gothtopia! Also featuring an untold tale of Catwoman in this tie-in to BATMAN: ZERO YEAR! Journey back to Selina's early days as a thief, and find out why she's always worked alone! Collects issues #25, #27-34"--

regency romance comics graphic novels.title: Beethoven
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: A family copes with a puppy that keeps getting bigger and bigger.

regency romance comics graphic novels.title: The Resolute Runaway
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: Knowing the risk of running away to find a new life, Joanna heads for Brussels, where young ladies are fair game for officers looking for love before facing the foe at Waterloo. When Joanna meets the heir to a dukedom, the only thing she has left to offer him is her heart. Original Regency Romance.

regency romance comics graphic novels.title: The uncanny X-Men Omnibus Volume 2
regency romance comics graphic novels.description: Chris Claremont, Dave Cockrum and John Byrne took a little reprint series called X-MEN and turned it into the all-new, all-different titan that conquered comicdom. Now, you can experience the thrills and excitemont of their classic tales from "The Dark Phoenix Saga" to "Days of Future Past" and so much more in this enormous Uncanny X-Men Omnibus! regency romance comics graphic novels.title: With This Ring
